findings.claim: README.md §9 states v2 has no doctor/upgrade/uninstall commands at all, which is stronger than and not fully covered by REVIEW-r4a finding #1 (which only flags the '7 tools' count). This is a full feature-removal statement that directly contradicts two settled owner decisions.
findings.evidence: docs/v2/README.md:101-103: '## 9. Tools [D]\n\n7 tools: ... No doctor, upgrade or uninstall commands. Errors explain the fix in one line.' This contradicts: ADR-0010 §Q16 (docs/v2/adr/0010-doctor-and-upgrade.md:69): 'uninstall is a mode of ctx_upgrade (mode: uninstall): stops the server, removes the cache...'; and DECISIONS-r3.md Q3b/Q16 which the owner accepted ('tamamı ok'): 'ctx_doctor and ctx_upgrade stay as tools, rebuilt for v2' and 'Uninstall is in v2.0 ... a mode of ctx_upgrade'. TECH-SPEC.md §3.11 (2026-10-14, marked [D]) also keeps both tools and documents FAIL classes from 35+70 v1 issues they fix.
findings.fix: Delete README.md:103's 'No doctor, upgrade or uninstall' sentence and the '7 tools' line in §9; replace with the 9-tool list matching PRD-v2.md:289 and TECH-SPEC §3.9/3.11, including ctx_doctor and ctx_upgrade (uninstall as its mode per Q16).
findings.note_on_prior_review: Extends REVIEW-r4a blocker #1 (tool-count contradiction) with a second, independent and more severe line in the same section that a pure tool-count fix would not catch, since it is a prose statement, not a count.

reopened_claims_checked.claim: REVIEW-r4a blocker #1: README.md:101 lists 7 tools vs PRD/TECH-SPEC 9 tools
reopened_claims_checked.evidence: docs/v2/README.md:101 reads '7 tools: ctx_execute (absorbs execute_file), ctx_batch, ctx_index (absorbs fetch_and_index), ctx_search, ctx_resume, ctx_stats, ctx_purge.' PRD-v2.md:289 reads '9 tools — ctx_execute, ctx_batch, ctx_index, ctx_search, ctx_resume, ctx_stats, ctx_doctor, ctx_upgrade, ctx_purge.' TECH-SPEC.md:289 GP1 row says 'tools/list (7 tools)' while TECH-SPEC.md §3.11 (same file) keeps ctx_doctor/ctx_upgrade as tools. Confirmed still present and unresolved; not repeated as a new finding, only re-verified.

limitations: Low-budget pass: checked one blocker claim plus one git-archaeology sweep for 'uninstall' history in cm-main; did not re-walk every [V] tag in the doc set due to time budget.
